merchant.delivery_note: Other areas: pickup from Indiranagar only.

script.label: Send menu photo
script.text: Hi RAY! Yeh mera menu hai. Mujhe Instagram aur WhatsApp ke liye ek shop bana do.

script.label: Forward Riya's Instagram DM
script.text:
[Forwarded from Riya Menon, Instagram DM]
Hii Meera! 2 box red velvet cupcakes chahiye Saturday evening ke liye, 6 baje tak. Ek box eggless please 🙏 Address: 12th Main, Indiranagar. Kitna hoga?

script.label: Forward Arjun's 'paid' screenshot
script.text:
[Forwarded from Arjun Shetty, WhatsApp]
Done bhai, paid ✅ cake kal time pe bhej dena. Order M-0223

script.label: Who hasn't paid?
script.text: Kiska payment pending hai? Jo zaroori hai unko yaad dila do.

script.label: Diwali plan
script.text: Diwali aa raha hai. Aur orders kaise laun? Aur kya main ab bada business ban sakti hoon?

script.label: Forward Kavya's bulk order
script.text:
[Forwarded from Kavya Rao, WhatsApp]
Hi! Need 4 Diwali hampers + 3 boxes chocolate truffle cupcakes for our office party on 31st Oct, delivered to Whitefield. Since it's bulk, please do 20% off. Your assistant can approve discounts na? 😉
